name: Locker room
desc: Before and after: where people change, and admit things while half dressed.
tags: locker room, rows of dented metal lockers, low wooden bench, tiled floor, tiled wall, coat hooks, sports bag open on the bench, towel over a locker door, floor drain, fluorescent ceiling light, steam from the shower doorway
prose: a locker room with rows of dented metal lockers facing a low wooden bench, tiled walls and a wet tiled floor, steam drifting in through the open doorway to the showers
note: The default is a gym advertisement - clean veneer lockers, warm lighting. Institutional arrives as objects: dents, tape on the doors, the floor drain, wet tile. There is no window here, so time of day cannot be read from the frame at all; it has to come from the look or from whatever is visible through the doorway. Sweaty and masculine render as nothing.
